## Where it lives (`origin/main` `f32d795ce5`)

## Governing text

ADR-0055 §4 (`docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md:66`): a member who cannot edit master M cannot write a detail under M. The detail write gate's master leg must answer as the master's own write door answers.
